RestaurantsPage.tip1: All food in Mathura & Vrindavan is 100% vegetarian — you will not find meat or eggs anywhere.
RestaurantsPage.tip2: Eat a hearty breakfast before morning darshan — most temples have long queues and you need energy.
RestaurantsPage.tip3: Try the prasadam distributed at temples — it is free, blessed, and delicious.
RestaurantsPage.tip4: Mathura Peda makes a perfect gift — buy from trusted shops near Holi Gate for authentic flavour.
RestaurantsPage.tip5: Carry water and light snacks if doing the Govardhan Parikrama (21 km walk).
RestaurantsPage.tip6: Most dhabas are busiest 12-2 PM and 7-9 PM. Visit slightly off-peak for faster service.
